events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has revealed the limits of US power and is affecting global geopolitics. The conflict is also impacting energy markets and trade relationships. The US Fed has held interest rates steady despite inflation concerns.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation is expected to lead to increased volatility in global markets. The US Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady may not be enough to mitigate the effects of inflation. Buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) and shorting the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) can help investors navigate this uncertainty.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US-Iran relations and Fed policy

events.exitStrategy: Exit positions if US-Iran tensions ease or Fed policy changes
